description: This file contains Dutch localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines translated messages for various user interface prompts and errors within the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message shown when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to remove excess characters when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters when input is below minimum.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown while loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching.
